items.description: One row of the markers document section — a producerless world-space overlay chip vocabulary: what projects markers (Source), which authored icon draws (Icon, resolved through the icon table like every other icon), whether it carries a radius ring (Ring), and its look (Style). Puck.Overlays owns only the drawing MECHANISM (a chip plate plus an optional ring); every row here supplies the MEANING.

id.description: The row's stable id, unique within the section.

source.description: Which rows (or literal point) this row projects a chip per.

anyOf.description: Tracks every declared speakers row — one chip per row, at the audio director's own resolved pose (the same pose the mix hears). WorldMarkerRing's radius field reads a tracked row's Radius when it is a bed; every other speaker kind draws no ring.
One static world-space chip at an authored position — tracks no document section.

icon.description: The icon name, resolved through icons.icons.

size.description: The icon chip's plate half-extent, px. Positive.

ringColor.description: The ring's stroke color. Required exactly when Ring is authored; omitted otherwise.

ringAlpha.description: The ring's opacity, in [0, 1]. Required exactly when Ring is authored; omitted otherwise.

ring.description: The radius-ring policy, or null for no ring.

field.description: The source row field the ring radius reads. The only field Speakers admits is radius (Radius); a row that is not a bed draws no ring under this policy without refusing (v1's one closed field name — a future source kind names its own).
